styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: soft mint-and-blush baby-gear ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of pure white #FFFFFF, misty mint #A9CBCB and soft blush #F2C6C2 backgrounds, deep pine-teal text #3E7078, pale mint #DFF0EC icon circles, and one warm sun-yellow accent #E8D44C used only on variant color cards and small highlight chips; neutral temperature balancing cool mint with warm blush; modern geometric sans-serif with rounded terminals and short headlines only; layered paper-cut mint wave backdrops and diagonal-stripe mint banner strips with thin outlined title boxes; rounded cards and circular blush feature medallions; thin-line circular outline icons in deep pine-teal #3E7078 with a consistent 2px stroke; bright soft high-key lighting with gentle contact shadows; product presented clean and centered at a stable scale inside rounded or circular masks; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no dense body text.

provenance.notes: 源为 800x1200 详情页长图的 15 片切板（panel-01~15，60px 重叠）。源图产品照片区域均为素材站的空白图块，产品身份由封面标题「宝宝安全学步车」与功能文案（手推防滑/静音轮/双刹车/防夹手/防撞杆/餐盘/免安装/四色）确认，与源文件名一致。与库内 suite-muying-xuebuche（防侧翻静音轮可折叠款，雾蓝+蜜金，侧视规格+折叠场景+轮子对比）区分：本款定位手推+双刹车+防夹手+四色，视觉语法为剪纸远山+樱粉+斜纹横幅+环形圆标+斜卡色板，分镜无重叠。已剥离：DW 素材水印、二维码会员贴片、店铺促销标语；源图具体数值（45/53/69/73cm）与测试类主张（欧美19种重金属检测、专利设计）一律改写为 {selling_point}/{callout} 文案槽，未写入任何不可证实事实；产品图区域空白属源素材本身状况，模版以版式与文案语法为准。
